description.value:
For performers who refuse to age out. The Pwr-Up Idol sings, sparkles and holds a three-hour set without sweating. Hello Cutie's talent agencies lease it as part of the contract, so read the part about who owns the body when the tour ends.

Cost: 13,500eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 36 (11d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Base chrome (no HL): FBC Gemini Sculpt, Techhair
Chrome: Adrenaline Convertor, AudioVox, Dancer Optics, Hello Cutie Sparkle-ize ×2, Kaleidoscopic Electric Reflection System (KERS), Light Tattoo ×3, Skin Weave

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
